Stelljes House
The Stelljes House is a historic house on New Hampshire Route 31 in Goshen, New Hampshire.
Built about 1800, it is one of the oldest of a cluster of plank-frame houses in Goshen.
The house was listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1985.
It has possibly been demolished.

Description and history
The Stelljes House stands in a rural area of southern Goshen, on the east side of NH 31.
It is a 1+1⁄2-story wooden structure, with a gabled roof and clapboarded exterior.

Geography
Carrizozo is located at the northern end of the Tularosa Basin, which extends southward to the New Mexico–Texas border.

The town itself is located in a flat area known prior to the founding of the town as the Corrizo flats, with typical Chihuahuan desert scrub and desert grasslands.To the west of the town is the Carrizozo Malpais, a 40-mile-long (64 km) lava flow that is about 1,500 years old and accessible through the Valley of Fires Recreation Area.
To the northeast is Carrizo Mountain, a 9,600-foot (2,900 m) peak within the Sacramento Mountains, and to the southeast are the Sierra Blanca mountain range.

Timnath, Colorado
The Town of Timnath is a Statutory Town located in Larimer County, Colorado, United States.

Founded in 1882, Timnath is a small agricultural/farming community located southeast of Fort Collins, Colorado, approximately one-half mile east of the Harmony Road/Interstate 25 interchange, on a small bluff east of the Cache la Poudre River.
The surrounding farmlands have been used primarily for potatoes, alfalfa, sugar beets, and cattle.
